newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds seen softly mixed ahead of Fed.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds seen softly mixed ahead of Fed.

text.p: Argentine bonds were slightly mixed amid very low volume in a cautious market ahed of the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting July 2, dealers said.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 opened slightly higher than its previous close of 93-7/8 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was almost flat. Thursday it closed at $117.90.
Dealers said the local market may cool down with some profit taking, although the underlying tone remains firm.
